steps.title: Create a GitHub Actions Workflow
steps.description: Create the directory structure and a basic CI workflow file.

steps.title: Write a Complete Pipeline
steps.description: Write a YAML pipeline with build and test steps.
tasks: Edit ci.yml to include: on push to main, checkout, setup-node, npm ci, npm test
Verify it contains the required keys: name, on, jobs

verification.command: grep -q 'jobs' /home/student/myproject/.github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q 'on' /home/student/myproject/.github/workflows/ci.yml && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Add a Deployment Stage
steps.description: Add a deploy job that depends on the test job.
tasks: Add a 'deploy' job with `needs: test` to your ci.yml
